config.enable-price-balancing.name: Enable Price Balancing
config.enable-price-balancing.tooltip: Dynamically scales base fish prices in Data/Objects based on catch difficulty and traits.
config.prevent-nerf.name: Prevent Price Nerfs
config.prevent-nerf.tooltip: Guarantees no vanilla fish will sell for less than its original vanilla base price.
config.base-floor.name: Base Price Floor
config.base-floor.tooltip: The absolute minimum base price added to all rod-caught fish before scaling.
config.linear-factor.name: Linear Factor
config.linear-factor.tooltip: Linear multiplier applied directly to difficulty D.
config.mid-tier-factor.name: Mid-Tier Quadratic Factor
config.mid-tier-factor.tooltip: Quadratic factor scaling mid-tier fish prices ((D/50)^2).
config.apex-factor.name: Apex Scaling Factor
config.apex-factor.tooltip: Scaling factor for high-tier fish with difficulty greater than 50.
config.apex-exponent.name: Apex Power Exponent
config.apex-exponent.tooltip: Exponential power applied to difficulty above 50.
config.price-rounding-interval.name: Price Rounding Interval
config.price-rounding-interval.tooltip: Rounds final evaluated fish prices to the nearest multiple (e.g. 5g).
config.smooth-movement-bonus.name: Smooth Movement Bonus
config.smooth-movement-bonus.tooltip: Bonus multiplier for smooth movement fish (e.g. Bream, Eel).
config.mixed-movement-bonus.name: Mixed Movement Bonus
config.mixed-movement-bonus.tooltip: Bonus multiplier for mixed movement fish (e.g. Carp, Salmon, Legend).
config.floater-movement-bonus.name: Floater Movement Bonus
config.floater-movement-bonus.tooltip: Bonus multiplier for floater movement fish (e.g. Pufferfish, Blobfish).
config.sinker-movement-bonus.name: Sinker Movement Bonus
config.sinker-movement-bonus.tooltip: Bonus multiplier for sinker movement fish (e.g. Squid, Octopus, Super Cucumber).
config.dart-movement-bonus.name: Dart Movement Bonus
config.dart-movement-bonus.tooltip: Bonus multiplier for dart movement fish (e.g. Catfish, Pike, Scorpion Carp).
config.rain-condition-bonus.name: Rain-Only Bonus
config.rain-condition-bonus.tooltip: Bonus multiplier for fish that can only be caught in the rain.
config.night-window-condition-bonus.name: Night / Tight Window Bonus
config.night-window-condition-bonus.tool: Bonus multiplier for night catches or fish with a tight time window (<= 6 hours).
config.single-season-condition-bonus.too: Bonus multiplier for fish exclusive to a single season.
config.isolated-location-bonus.name: Isolated Location Bonus
config.isolated-location-bonus.tooltip: Bonus multiplier for fish exclusive to niche locations (Secret Woods, Mines, Swamp, Desert, Submarine, etc.).
config.legendary-multiplier-bonus.name: Legendary Prize Multiplier
config.legendary-multiplier-bonus.toolti: Dedicated prize bonus multiplier for Legendary and Qi Extended Family fish (+100% / 2x prize).
config.enable-predictable-hash-bonus.too: Applies a deterministic per-species signature bonus (0% to +8%) derived from ItemId.
config.enable-fishing-chest-buff.name: Enable Fishing Chest Buff
config.enable-fishing-chest-buff.tooltip: Enhance fishing treasure chests by adjusting the roll decay multiplier, giving more rolls of vanilla-faithful loot.
config.fishing-chest-decay-rate.name: Standard Chest Decay Rate
config.fishing-chest-decay-rate.tooltip: Roll probability decay multiplier for regular fishing treasure chests (vanilla default is 0.40; mod default is 0.60).
config.golden-chest-decay-rate.name: Golden Chest Decay Rate
config.golden-chest-decay-rate.tooltip: Roll probability decay multiplier for 1.6 golden fishing treasure chests (vanilla default is 0.60; mod default is 0.80).
config.enable-fishing-exp-balancing.name: Enable Fishing EXP Balancing
config.enable-fishing-exp-balancing.tool: Enables targeted experience bonuses for challenging apex fish (Difficulty >= 85) and Legendary achievements, keeping standard fish at 100% vanilla EXP.
config.apex-fish-exp-bonus.name: Apex Fish EXP Bonus
config.apex-fish-exp-bonus.tooltip: Bonus experience added to challenging fish catches with Difficulty >= 85 (e.g. Lingcod, Ice Pip, Scorpion Carp, Lava Eel, Octopus; default: +15 EXP).
config.legendary-fish-exp-bonus.name: Legendary Fish EXP Bonus
config.legendary-fish-exp-bonus.tooltip: Bonus experience added to all Legendary and Extended Family fish catches (default: +60 EXP).
config.enable-crab-pot-price-balancing.t: Rebalances base sell prices for all 10 Crab Pot catches (Lobster 200g, Crab 150g, Crayfish 110g, Snail/Oyster 95g, Shrimp 90g, Cockle/Clam 75g, Mussel 55g, Periwinkle 45g).
config.enable-crab-pot-exp-balancing.too: Awards tiered harvesting experience for Crab Pots (Lobster 24 EXP, Crab 16 EXP, Delicacies 12 EXP, Shellfish 8 EXP, Trash 5 EXP).
config.enable-crab-pot-trash-reduction.t: Significantly nerfs crab pot trash rates by rerolling trash catches into valid local shellfish.
config.crab-pot-trash-reroll-chance.name: Trash Reroll Chance
config.crab-pot-trash-reroll-chance.tool: Probability of converting a trash roll into a genuine shellfish catch (default: 0.65 / 65%, dropping trash rates from ~38% to ~13%).
config.enable-fish-pond-quality.name: Enable Fish Pond Quality
config.enable-fish-pond-quality.tooltip: Enables star quality (Silver, Gold, Iridium) on Roe produced by Fish Ponds based on pond population and daily luck.
config.enable-caviar-rebalance.name: Enable Caviar Rebalance
config.enable-caviar-rebalance.tooltip: Rebalances base sell price for Sturgeon Caviar in Data/Objects.
config.caviar-base-price.name: Caviar Base Price
config.caviar-base-price.tooltip: Base sell price for Caviar before Artisan and star quality multipliers (default: 800g; 1,120g Artisan / 2,240g Iridium Artisan).
